summary.text: Edmond Jordan is a Democratic member of the Louisiana House of Representatives for District 29, representing East Baton Rouge and West Baton Rouge, according to the House member page.
The page lists 2016 as the year elected.

paragraphs.text: The House member page lists Edmond Jordan's occupation as Attorney and Co-Owner of Cypress Insurance Agency, Inc..
It lists Edmond Jordan's education as Brusly High School; Southern University and A&M College; Southern University Law Center.
The House member page lists Edmond Jordan's committee assignments as Commerce; Insurance; Judiciary; House Executive Committee; Legislative Audit Advisory Council.
It lists caucus and delegation affiliations as Louisiana Legislative Black Caucus (Chair); Capital Region Legislative Delegation; Democratic Caucus.
